en.title: Subscription Expiry Guidelines
en.excerpt: Understanding operational access, historical data retention, and feature locking when subscription periods conclude.
en.content:
Active vs Expired State

When an Organizer account has an active quota balance, all administrative features remain fully accessible. When all tournament quota slots are consumed or an active package period ends, the account enters maintenance mode.

Permanent Data Preservation

Archeris never deletes historical tournament data. Even after package expiration:

  • Past tournament results, qualification scores, and elimination trees remain permanently accessible.
  • Public leaderboard links and participant certificates continue to function for historical verification.
  • PDF Result Books and score reports remain available for download.

Locked Features During Expiry

While in an expired state, modification actions are locked:

  • Creating new tournaments or adding new categories to existing drafts is paused.
  • Publishing unpublished draft tournaments is restricted.
  • Scorekeeper mobile login codes cannot be generated for new events.

Reactivating Your Account

To restore full editing and publishing capabilities, simply purchase a new tournament quota package from the dashboard. All existing draft configurations will instantly unlock without data loss.
